description: Vegan-friendly lace-up for long indoor sessions, with a seamless microfiber toe area and 4 mm S-72 half sole.

name: Boostic
description: Precise edging shoe for micro footholds, with a multi-panel microfiber upper and full-length Vibram XS Edge sole.

officialSpecs.upper: Multi-panel microfiber upper with an Alcantara insert wrapping the big toe for superior comfort. Elastic gusset facilitates foot entry, while dual Velcro straps ensure a secure fit, providing stability during use.
officialSpecs.midsole: Minimal 1 mm Flexan insert designed to optimize sensitivity.
officialSpecs.sole: Vibram® XS EDGE, full-length with a thickness of 3,5 mm, provides support across the entire arch, ensuring stability and high performance even on small edges.

name: Mago
description: High-precision shoe for micro footholds, with perforated microfiber panels, TPS forefoot insert and Vibram XS Grip2 rubber.

officialSpecs.upper: Made up of perforated elastic microfiber panels reinforced by a triple-layer microfiber frame. Combined with the lacing system, it ensures an optimal fit and effective wrapping, featuring a smooth inner surface in contact with the skin. The toe panel includes an extra-large microfiber insert extending under the footbed.
officialSpecs.midsole: The pre-shaped TPS insert provides a concave profile and good sensitivity on the big toe. The heel is reinforced with a Flexan strip to ensure tension and stability.
officialSpecs.sole: Vibram® XS GRIP 2 spread over 1/3 of the length, with a thickness of 3,5 mm to ensure maximum flexibility.

name: Booster
description: Soft, precise slipper-style shoe with a multi-panel microfiber upper, minimal Flexan insert and Vibram XS Grip2 rubber.

officialSpecs.upper: Constructed entirely from microfiber, composed of multiple shaped panels to ensure a precise and comfortable fit. The dual Velcro strap closure system facilitates easy entry and secures the foot, providing stability to the arch.
officialSpecs.midsole: A minimal Flexan insert designed to optimize sensitivity, with support strips extending along the entire length of the foot.
officialSpecs.sole: Vibram® XS GRIP 2 spread over 1/3 of the length, with a thickness of 3,5 mm to ensure maximum flexibility.

name: Pikij Kids
description: Foot-friendly kids' shoe with a microfiber and Lycra upper, wide velcro strap and full-length Vision rubber sole.

officialSpecs.upper: Made of microfiber and Lycra, with a suede leather panel supporting the foot. The wide Velcro closure ensures quick and secure adjustment. An EVA insert positioned under the heel enhances impact absorption, contributing to the overall comfort of the shoe.
officialSpecs.midsole: The front lacks a midsole, relying instead on 4 mm of rubber and an EVA insert that together provide sufficient support for a lightweight user.
officialSpecs.sole: Full-length Vision rubber, 4 mm thick, designed to provide grip and durability.
